title: SSHfolio
description: SSHfolio is a modular TUI (Text User Interface) portfolio application based on the Bubble Tea framework. This project allows you to showcase your portfolio in a terminal environment, providing a unique way to present your projects, biography, contact information, and more.

title: Bentofolio
description: Bentofolio is my personal portfolio project that showcases my skills and expertise through a bento grid-style layout. Built using Nuxt.js and TailwindCSS, it offers an interactive and visually appealing interface.

title: AEV-Software
description: The Alset Solar Cybersedan Software is a comprehensive full-stack ecosystem developed for the FAUHS AEV solar car, enabling seamless integration and operation of various hardware components.

title: Devfolify
description: Devfolify is a full stack application designed to provide personalized coding challenges. Our goal is to move beyond the traditional lists of beginner or advanced projects and offer unique, skill-level tailored challenges.

title: Schedulix
description: Schedulix is a program that helps university students develop their course schedules for their upcoming semester. It takes in the user's preferences and generates multiple schedules that fit the user's preferences.

title: WebDevDocs
description: A no-nonsense web development course meant to help guide learners to develop web applications the right way, with basic instruction and explanation followed by practice and mini project-based experimenting.

title: MemeAPI
description: A fun API built with ElysiaJS using Bun runtime that serves random memes and funny content.

title: eXit
description: A recreation of the game eXit as seen in the television series Mr. Robot in season 4 episode 11, served through an actual terminal via SSH.

title: Ansify
description: A Go package that turns any image into color-coded ANSI blocks for terminal display, solving the readability issues of traditional ASCII image converters.

title: Accessh
description: An SSH-based directory of services and applications, providing navigation assistance to various SSH-accessible tools in my infrastructure.
